result.title: SPEM: Scan-Prior Entropy Modeling for LiDAR Point Cloud Compression
result.summary: LiDAR point clouds exhibit scan-induced spatial regularities that are informative for geometry compression. Existing scan-aware approaches often exploit these regularities by transforming coded geometry into spherical or beam-aligned coordinate systems. However, this couples acquisition priors with geometry representation, altering spatial partitioning and quantization, and potentially preventing exact recovery of the original Cartesian geometry. We argue that acquisition priors should guide probability modeling rather than dictate the coding representation. We propose SPEM, a Scan-Prior Entropy Modeling framework that exploits LiDAR scanning regularities within the entropy model without requiring coordinate transformation. We introduce a multi-frequency spherical rotary positional encoding that captures scan-aligned spatial relationships in both backbone self-attention and decoded-context retrieval. Building upon this encoding, we develop a decoded-memory autoregressive predictor that efficiently exploits previously decoded occupancy information through reusable key/value caches. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in both lossy and lossless LiDAR geometry compression, highlighting the effectiveness of scan-prior modeling across different coordinate representations.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SPEM 框架，主张让 LiDAR 扫描先验只引导概率建模而不改变编码表示，通过多频球面旋转位置编码把扫描对齐的空间关系注入注意力，并用带可复用 KV cache 的解码记忆自回归预测器提升几何压缩性能。
AI.relevance_reason: 其将采集先验写入注意力位置结构与缓存上下文的做法，可能与 LVR 关心几何、空间关系如何在内部状态和缓存中保留与检索的问题有概念联系，但领域相距较远，可供核查的借鉴有限。
